description:
Slow tests are refactored, never excused. 0b35be66's final whole-workspace run put three more unit tests within 25 % of the 2 s limit, close enough that f487aeef's enforced limits would fail cargo-ci at a load just under its loaded-host threshold.

## Background

The limits are the per-layer values in `dev/benchmarks/per-test-durations-1eb949a5/README.md`: 2 s for lib and bin targets. In 0b35be66's run `after3` (2026-11-08 04:37, 1-minute load 3.93):

- `storage::claim_coordinator::proptests::test_sequence_numbers_monotonic`: 1.739 s
- `commands::gate_check::tests::test_repository_validation_records_a_repository_judged_wrong_as_a_failed_run`: 1.648 s
- `commands::gate_check::tests::test_capture_gate_evaluation_image_holds_only_the_evaluated_issues_named_runs`: 1.620 s

0b35be66 adds the shared mechanisms to reuse: a zero lock wait for contended claim proptests, and unsynced `JsonFileStorage` fixtures (`setup_unsynced_test_repo_with_config`, `unsynced_file_executor`). The method and evidence format are in `dev/benchmarks/per-test-durations-1eb949a5/remeasure-0b35be66/README.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the three tests runs under 1.5 s in a whole-workspace nextest run on a quiet host (1-minute load below 4), and a committed note under `dev/benchmarks/per-test-durations-1eb949a5/` records each one's duration before and after with the run's load.
- [hard] REQ-02: No refactored test sleeps or waits on wall-clock time to observe the property it owns.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each test still owns the property it owned before, at the same or a cheaper layer, with no weakened assertion, no reduced case count or generator range, no ignored test, and no deletion unless the property moves to another owning test.

## Notes

If a test cannot meet the target without losing its property, report it as a blocking concern rather than raising a limit.
title: Bring the three near-limit unit tests under 1.5 s
